'''Jafan''' was a [[General/Legends|general]]<ref name="Nexus">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> and eventual [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|king]] of the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Inside" /> During the [[Time of Suffering/Legends|Time of Suffering]],<ref name="Nexus" /> a roughly two-[[Standard century/Legends|century]]-long civil war between [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[City-state/Legends|city-states]],<ref name="Starships">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|36|In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}}</ref> General Jafan united the factions through force of will and military strength, ushering in the [[Great Time of Peace/Legends|Great Time of Peace]], a golden age for Naboo.<ref name="Nexus" />

Jafan became the first [[King/Legends|king]] of the new era,<ref name="Inside" /> and in [[832 BBY/Legends|832 BBY]], they directed the construction of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] in the newly founded [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="Nexus" /> The palace was built in the heart of the city in tribute to [[Gender/Legends|King]] Jafan, with a network of streets and plazas stretching out from it.<ref name="Starships" /> Jafan also built the handcrafted [[Turret Room/Legends|Turret Room]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|268|turret room}}</ref> and a small [[Theed temple|temple]] at the rear of the palace, the latter of which would be used by Naboo's monarchs to pay homage to their predecessors.<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jafan was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
